sources.title: Sources
sources.description: One per line: a podcast RSS or Atom feed URL, an Apple Podcasts show or episode link (used only to find the public feed), or a direct audio or video file URL. YouTube, Spotify and other platforms are refused.

maxEpisodesPerFeed.title: Max episodes per feed
maxEpisodesPerFeed.description: How many episodes to take from each feed, newest first by publish date (feed order when dates are missing).

publishedAfter.title: Published after
publishedAfter.description: Optional date (YYYY-MM-DD). Episodes published before it are skipped before anything is downloaded.

language.title: Language
language.description: auto detects the spoken language from the audio (the feed's language tag is not trusted). Or a two-letter ISO 639-1 code such as en or he.

preferPublisherTranscript.title: Prefer the publisher's transcript
preferPublisherTranscript.description: Use the transcript the publisher lists in the feed (podcast:transcript, VTT, SRT, JSON or text) when it is valid, instead of transcribing the audio.

addOns.title: Add-ons
addOns.description: Optional summary, chapters and key quotes per episode. Key quotes are kept only when they appear word for word in the transcript.

speakerLabels.title: Speaker labels
speakerLabels.description: Label speaker turns (spk_1, spk_2, ...). Uses an engine that supports speakers and adds the speaker-minute event.

wordTimestamps.title: Word timestamps
wordTimestamps.description: Adds a words array with a start and end time for every word to the JSON file (not to the dataset row).

outputFormats.title: Output files
outputFormats.description: Transcript files saved in the run's key-value store; their links are in the files field of each row.

maxAudioMinutesPerEpisode.title: Longest episode (minutes)
maxAudioMinutesPerEpisode.description: Episodes longer than this are skipped with episode_too_long and are not charged.

maxTotalAudioMinutes.title: Max audio minutes per run
maxTotalAudioMinutes.description: A run-wide guard: once this many audio minutes are used, further episodes are skipped with run_minute_cap.

downloadStallSeconds.title: Download stall time (seconds)
downloadStallSeconds.description: If the audio host sends no data for this many seconds, the episode fails with download_stall_timeout.

episodeTimeoutMinutes.title: Episode time limit (minutes)
episodeTimeoutMinutes.description: Wall-clock limit per episode, from download to result. A slower episode fails with episode_timeout; the rest continue.

confirmRights.title: I may transcribe these recordings
confirmRights.description: Required. Confirm the recordings are yours, licensed to you, or used for permitted personal, research or accessibility purposes.
